If DesignCapacity differs, attempt bounded RAM-only 68mAh FCC/design and 4mAh NearFull setup while charging above 3.5V, read back and reseal. Preserve learned FCC when design already matches. No OTP, charger, calibration or cell-curve writes. Hide SOC while capacity mismatches.
